purpose: Define the supervised AI workforce assignment model for SEIS without granting uncontrolled repository, credential, deployment, or merge authority.

notes: The command checks local route readiness only.
No provider call, repository upload, secret read, or live model verification was performed.
Missing environment-variable status does not prove a credential does not exist outside the current shell.

truthBoundary: Workforce assignments are source-backed role and launcher metadata. Installed status is not live-model, authentication, provider-call, execution, or external-mutation evidence; Codex remains the only repository writer by default.

writerPolicy.rule: Exactly one assistant may hold writer role for a change package. Other assistants provide scoped review, research, design, or contradiction analysis unless explicitly handed off.
writerPolicy.handoffRequirement: A handoff must include objective, affected paths, context included, context excluded, risks, expected output, validation command, and approval boundary.

credentialBoundary.rule: API keys may be available in the operator environment, but keys are never copied into prompts, docs, commits, browser storage, logs, handoff files, or review artifacts.
credentialBoundary.runtimePattern: Live provider use must go through server-side environment variables or an approved backend gateway. The core SEIS product remains usable with zero cloud-provider keys.

safetyRules: Codex remains final repository integration and validation owner.
Secondary assistants must review bounded context, not the entire repository by default.
No assistant receives secrets, private keys, .env contents, or production credentials.
No assistant may merge, deploy, rotate secrets, rewrite history, delete branches, or run SSH commands without explicit human approval.
AI-generated output is untrusted until Codex compares it against repository evidence.
Design outputs must be treated as proposals until implemented and validated.
Public-readiness claims require security, license, documentation, and validation evidence.
Local/offline models are preferred for sensitive summaries and private draft analysis.
Fallback model identity must remain truthful; a non-Anthropic response must not be called Claude.
Archive or old prompt material may be summarized, but not promoted into source-of-truth docs without review.

workflow.output: Bounded objective, affected paths, risk class, and validation target.
Architecture, product, AGENTS, SECURITY, and ARCHITECTURE alignment notes.
Contradictions, duplicate archive material, risky assumptions, and stale prompt findings.
Public readiness, UX, accessibility, documentation clarity, and external-doc consistency notes.
Visual-system proposals for Command Center, SEIS Desktop, SEIS Code, Video Hero, and Mythic Gacha.
Offline or local-only summaries and drafts for sensitive repository context.
Repository edits, docs updates, bug fixes, focused validation, and commit-ready diff.
Automated lint, build, tests, docs checks, provider audit, and secret scanning where configured.
Pull-request review comments after a PR exists.
Fixes for review findings, final status report, and human approval queue.

coreDuties: Inspect repository state.
Apply focused file edits.
Fix bugs and documentation drift.
Run available validation.
Prepare small reviewable commits and PR descriptions.
assignments.validationDuty: Compare every secondary-agent recommendation against repository evidence before accepting it.

coreDuties: Review architecture and product strategy.
Check AGENTS, SECURITY, ARCHITECTURE, and ROADMAP alignment.
Review high-risk PRs and cross-layer decisions.
assignments.validationDuty: Produce decision-oriented review notes with explicit evidence gaps.

coreDuties: Find contradictions between docs, prompts, and implementation claims.
Analyze duplicate or stale archive material.
Challenge weak assumptions and hidden risk.
deniedActions: promoting archive content into official docs without Codex review
assignments.validationDuty: Flag exact conflicting files or claims so Codex can repair them.

coreDuties: Provide second-opinion review for public readiness.
Check UX, accessibility, and documentation clarity.
Support Google ecosystem and source comparison tasks when authorized.
deniedActions: unbounded web or provider calls without approval
assignments.validationDuty: Separate observed repository evidence from external or inferred recommendations.

coreDuties: Review PR diffs after a pull request exists.
Surface code, docs, security, and maintainability comments.
Keep review scoped to the submitted change package.
assignments.validationDuty: Codex triages each comment and fixes only evidence-backed issues.

coreDuties: Create local-only drafts for sensitive summaries.
Help with offline analysis when cloud providers are unavailable or inappropriate.
Support no-key fallback experiments without claiming live provider output.
assignments.validationDuty: Label output as local/offline draft until Codex verifies it.

coreDuties: Propose visual systems for Command Center.
Propose SEIS Desktop and SEIS Code interface refinements.
Propose Video Hero and Mythic Gacha visual directions.
assignments.validationDuty: Design proposals need implementation, accessibility, and browser evidence before release claims.

coreDuties: Run CI validation on configured events.
Run tests, lint, build, docs checks, provider audits, and secret scans where configured.
Expose failures as review evidence.
assignments.validationDuty: CI output is evidence only for checks actually configured and executed.

coreDuties: Support multilingual review, localization, and translation tasks when available.
If a Kimi Code route is configured, provide bounded code second opinions under Codex review.
assignments.validationDuty: Codex must verify any Kimi-generated code or copy against repository conventions.

coreDuties: Provide terminal coding assistance for bounded local tasks.
Generate narrow patch suggestions when Codex delegates explicitly.
assignments.validationDuty: Codex remains responsible for applying, reviewing, and validating any suggested patch.

approvalRequiredFor: paid or live provider smoke tests
nextSafeActions: Use this assignment matrix to prepare bounded prompts for each reviewer.
Keep Codex as the only writer for the next repository change package.
Run the quality gate after changing the AI workforce matrix or related docs.
Add package.json script alias only after the current dirty package changes are reconciled.
